description: How many PARALLEL pull requests a dependency may have open, not how risky its versions are.
With separation off Renovate only offers the newest version: a module two majors behind
gets only the jump to newest. Separation splits the offers into independent
branches so intermediate steps stay takeable, in order.
Branch shape only: risk grading lives in override-breaking-changes.json and
override-release-age.json; update types still come from the version delta, so commit
Extended after github>ppat/renovate-presets:kubernetes to override it: that preset sets
separateMinorPatch true for flux2/kubernetes/kubectl/kindest; module directories want the
opposite, outside subsystem paths the preset's value stands.
apps subsystems and the bootstrap CRD copies. separateMinorPatch FALSE: a patch is the
routine bump; splitting it from the minor stream doubles pull-request volume for no
decision made differently. separateMultipleMajor TRUE so a module two majors behind
gets one pull request per major rather than only the jump to newest; separateMultipleMinor
FALSE because accumulated minors are taken in one step.
infra subsystems: as above, except separateMultipleMinor is TRUE. Several infra
dependencies document a supported upgrade PATH rather than a jump (Longhorn and Flux are
the standing examples); collapsing accumulated minors into one pull request would offer a
hop the vendor does not support. One pull request per minor keeps the path takeable.
